description: Add Plugin System (agentwork/plugins/) - load custom tools from external packages at runtime with plugin discovery, lifecycle management, manifest metadata, and hot-reload support.
steps: Create agentwork/plugins/manifest.py with PluginManifest pydantic model: name (str), version (str), description (str), author (str, default=''), tools (List[str] - tool names the plugin provides), dependencies (List[str], default=[]), entry_point (str - dotted module path or file path).

Create agentwork/plugins/plugin.py with Plugin class: holds a PluginManifest, a loaded state (bool), and a list of Tool instances. Methods: load() - imports the module from entry_point and collects Tool instances, unload() - clears tools and marks as unloaded, reload() - unload then load. The load mechanism: import the module, scan for Tool instances (isinstance check on module attributes).

Create agentwork/plugins/manager.py with PluginManager class: Methods: discover(directory: str) -> List[PluginManifest] (scans directory for plugin.json manifest files), load_plugin(manifest: PluginManifest) -> Plugin, unload_plugin(name: str), reload_plugin(name: str), get_plugin(name: str) -> Optional[Plugin], list_plugins() -> List[Plugin], get_all_tools() -> List[Tool] (aggregates tools from all loaded plugins). Discovery also supports entry_points group 'agentwork.plugins' (best effort, not required for tests).

Create tests/test_plugins.py: Test PluginManifest validation, test PluginManager.discover() with a temp directory containing a plugin.json and a Python module with @tool-decorated functions, test load/unload/reload lifecycle, test get_all_tools aggregation, test loading invalid module handles gracefully.
Export PluginManager, Plugin, PluginManifest from agentwork/__init__.py and add to __all__
acceptance_criteria: PluginManager can discover plugins from a directory by scanning for plugin.json files
Plugins can be loaded, unloaded, and reloaded (hot-reload)
Loaded plugins expose Tool instances that work with the Agent framework
Invalid plugins fail gracefully with error info rather than crashing
All new tests pass: python3 -m pytest tests/test_plugins.py -q
